messages.text:
I can’t refund all three today: the shop records show two napkins received back, but not the third. Only items received back can be refunded. Would you like to request a refund for the two received napkins? (refund-policy/v2/return)

For identical items, the discounted total is divided equally, rounded down to the nearest cent, with any leftover cents added to the last units. These shares are fixed and aren’t recalculated. Your napkins were allocated **BRL 91.00 each**, so the two total **BRL 182.00**. (refund-policy/v2/amount)

A refund requires your confirmation using the proposal card’s button and staff approval; I can’t promise completion today. (refund-policy/v2/approval) (refund-policy/v2/payout)
